actions.action: Merge paragraph edits using causal history.
actions.mechanism: Merge immutable edits by paragraph ID; causal ancestry distinguishes superseding edits from concurrent alternatives without trusting clocks.
actions.implementation: Persist device/revision identifiers, parent revisions, original text, and deletion tombstones locally; exchange missing events through the existing synchronization path.
actions.check: Independent edits survive both reconnect orders; concurrent edit/edit and deletion/edit operations retain their alternatives and attribution.
actions.risk: Logical revision numbers alone cannot establish cross-device causality.

actions.action: Separate paragraph placement from paragraph text.
actions.mechanism: Independent placement revisions let reordering coexist with prose edits; stable sorting produces a deterministic paragraph sequence.
actions.implementation: Give placements variable-length sortable position keys; append device/revision tie-breakers. Retain concurrent placements, selecting a deterministic provisional placement until resolution.
actions.check: Replay simultaneous moves and text edits in either order; require identical sequences, unchanged prose, and inspectable competing placements.
actions.risk: Position keys grow; premature renumbering can invalidate offline placements.

actions.action: Make conflict resolution an attributed edit.
actions.mechanism: An explicit resolution references competing revisions, preserving authorship instead of silently selecting a winner.
actions.implementation: Show verbatim alternatives, author/device, and revision; represent deletion explicitly. Save the user's resolution with all reviewed alternatives as parents.
actions.check: A later-arriving unreviewed edit remains unresolved; simultaneous resolutions remain alternatives. Over-limit results require user correction, never truncation.
actions.risk: History consumes storage; do not expire unresolved originals after 48 hours.

actions.mechanism: Fixed operation histories and delivery permutations expose order dependence, lost authorship, and accidental conflict suppression.
actions.implementation: Fork a shared note; script independent edits, same-paragraph edits, moves, and deletion versus edit. Replay both reconnect orders with duplicates and restarts.
actions.check: Require identical canonical state, surviving independent edits, verbatim attributed conflicts, and unresolved deletion/edit alternatives; include 500-paragraph and 8-KB boundary fixtures.
actions.risk: Compare semantic state, not incidental log insertion order.
